assessment: The source fits the 10:00–11:00 UT gradient magnitudes in the first four lower-energy WCDA bins to alpha(E/TeV)^gamma, reports alpha=0.010±0.001 and gamma=-0.53±0.12, and separately lists the corresponding median energies 0.7, 1.0, 1.5, and 3.1 TeV. The card excludes the upper-limit bins, preserves the normalization and one-TeV reference, identifies the gradient-magnitude readout, gives the four-point Cartesian domain, records the time window, and uses exact locators. Deterministic evaluation uses the reported central fit rather than sampling its uncertainties.

issues.detail: The normalization and spectral index are fitted estimates with reported uncertainties; the deterministic relation uses only their central values, as the card states.

controls.definition: Median primary cosmic-ray energy of a WCDA energy bin.
controls.name: median_cosmic_ray_energy

applicability.statement: The best-fit power law applies to the first four lower-energy WCDA bins during 10:00-11:00 UT on November 4, 2021; the highest WCDA bin and KM2A points were treated as upper limits and are excluded.
The central parameter values are fitted estimates with reported uncertainties of 0.001 for the normalization and 0.12 for the spectral index.

readouts.definition: Magnitude g of the fitted relative-intensity skymap gradient during the transient anisotropy event.
readouts.name: gradient_magnitude
